visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman walk side-by-side towards the camera through a vast, sun-drenched outdoor plaza. The woman on the right wears a pale pink short-sleeved button-up shirt with matching high-waisted shorts, a red shoulder bag, and glasses. She gestures expressively with her hands as she speaks. The man on the left wears a white polo shirt, blue jeans, and dark sunglasses, listening attentively while walking with one hand in his pocket. Behind them, the massive gothic facade of a cathedral (Milan Cathedral) rises with its intricate stone spires and white marble architecture. Numerous other pedestrians are blurred in the background, creating a busy urban atmosphere. Large white text overlays appear periodically at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The video cuts to a static graphic end screen with a clean white background. Centered at the top is a clinic logo with the text "美上美皮膚科診所" and "DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC". Below the logo, a series of gray and dark gray banners list social media contact information including a Line ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses. Icons for locations and phones are clearly visible next to the text. The bottom of the screen features a friendly call-to-action phrase in both traditional Chinese and English.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a mid-high pitched female voice and a deeper male voice speaking in a clear, conversational Mandarin. The dialogue is overlayed on a bright, acoustic guitar-driven BGM featuring a steady 4/4 pop beat at 120 BPM. The acoustic environment is an outdoor field recording, capturing a low-level crowd murmur and distant urban atmosphere. The voices are enunciated well despite the background noise. (2) As the conversation reaches a more emphatic point about needle-free injections, the female voice's pitch variability increases with a rising intonation, showing excitement. The BGM remains constant in volume and rhythm. Occasional soft rustling of clothing or microphones is audible as the speakers walk, but the speech-to-noise ratio remains high, ensuring clarity. (3) A subtle digital transition sound, a soft 'poof' or bubble effect, occurs just as the dialogue ends. The BGM continues momentarily into the final segment. The environmental noise floor drops away as the voices cease, replaced by a clean studio-quality silence or post-produced digital space for the outro jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to promote a specific medical beauty treatment called Curejet, emphasizing its needle-free nature to attract patients who fear pain or injections. By showcasing a relaxed discussion between professionals in a high-end travel setting (Milan), it builds lifestyle appeal and medical credibility simultaneously.
